Definition: Cham, a son of Noah; also (as a patronymic) his descendants or their country
BiblicalUsage: Ham = "hot"; n pr m; 1) 2nd son of Noah, father of Canaan and of various peoples which were inhabitants of southern lands; 2) in late usage, a collective name for Egyptians; n pr loc; 3) the place where Chedorlaomer smote the Zuzim, probably in the territory of Ammonites (Gilead) east of the Jordan
